name: Battle Tokens
detailed_description:
Battle Tokens is a free-to-play, turn-based tactics RPG that squeezes the thrill of a tabletop dungeon crawl into bite-size multiplayer matches. Pick a class, slide your 2D token across a living grid, and repel wave after wave of goblins, orcs, undead—and, if you last long enough, dragons—while story quests shape the fate of the realm. Play solo, queue with strangers, or host a private lobby for up to 9 heroes.

Key Features

Token-Based Tactics

No rulebook required: chain abilities and status ailments in lightning-fast encounters that feel like a Friday-night D&D skirmish brought to life.

Choose a Class, Master a Build

Launch lineup: Warrior, Archer, Mage, Healer (more on the roadmap). Each offers unique stats, abilities, and gear synergies—from glass-cannon fire mages to shield-wall bruisers.

Massive Co-op

Up to 9-player online co-op. Utilize your class specialties to protect your allies, kill the enemies, or heal your friends.

Quest-Driven Progression

Escort caravans, defend relics, purge elite foes. Every run strings dynamic objectives into a mini-story that feeds the larger campaign.

Roguelite Leveling system

Earn gold, unlock new skills, and shop between runs for gear. Opt into endless Survival mode to chase legendary drops.

Unique-Style Art

Bold outlines, flat fills, and a medieval-pub UI bring the battlefield to life, backed by lute-laden tavern tunes.

Built for 10-Minute Bursts or All-Night Raids

Missions run ~30 min; Survival can last as long as 100 waves, can you make it to the end?

Cross-Play on the Way

Planned launch on PC first, with mobile releasing soon after—party with friends on phones while you camp in your gaming chair. Controllers are supported!

Free to play.

Will your party’s tokens become legend—or shatter under the next boss’s crushing blow? Wishlist now!

(More content to come! Still adding more classes, enemies, items, and missions!)
